newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -T-bonds to dip before aiming for 115-17.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -T-bonds to dip before aiming for 115-17.

text.p: September T-bond futures are looking towards an eventual target of 115-17, but while they are below 114-18 selling pressure would hamper that view, technical analysts said on Friday.
"The market has been focused on 115-17 for the last week or so," said David Wood, an independent technical analyst near London.
September T-bond futures were at 114-10, down 12/32 in automated trade by 0904 GMT.
Wood said while T-bonds were below 114-18 they were looking soft.
But there was support four ticks either side of 114-00, he added, which might be tested later in the session.
In the longer-term, he suggested a bounce from 113-20.
"Below that it starts looking wrong for an upside," he said.
The market was left with further support at 113-07 to 113-03, Wood said.
Francoise Skelley, head of global trading technical analysis at Credit Suisse First Boston in London, said the market was overbought, and suggested a pullback to 114-05 to 114-00.
"The market is overstretched and needs some consolidation," she said.
But she too suggested 115-17 as a future target for the longer term.
Wood said that the market might reach 115-17 if it was focused, but would encounter a lot of selling on the way.
December Eurodollar futures were at 94.055, down 0.010 on the day.
